title: Mutation gate per chunk from chunk 1

record.title: Mutation gate per chunk from chunk 1
record.requirement: every chunk's diff is mutation-tested as part of the harness `run` and in CI; any missed or timed-out mutant makes the run red, a missing diff base fails rather than passes vacuously, and each guard test in a chunk plan is paired with its own remove-the-guard mutation; obs code is mutated like product code.
record.observed_gap: `cargo-mutants` is installed on the host; no project runs it (H:55-59).

verification.acceptance: `agent-run run --mutants` mutation-tests the chunk diff: the working tree plus untracked files from the merge-base of the base, where the base is `AGENT_RUN_CHUNK_BASE`, then `git merge-base HEAD origin/main`, then `github.event.before` or the PR base sha in CI. An unreachable base (the all-zero sha included) exits 1 with `reason:"base-missing"` and leaves no `target/agent-run/chunk.diff`. The verdict reads `mutants.out/outcomes.json`: any missed or timed-out mutant, or a cargo-mutants exit of 1/4/5/6/70, exits 1. Unit tests over fixture outcomes prove each of these branches. The ubuntu `mutants` CI job runs the same command on every push and pull_request, and it concluded success on the push that carries this chunk. This chunk's own run on base `13b7ee32e6227d1cb6cecc96fbe412fe34a4e0e6` exits 0 with the `mutants` suite `survived: 0`, over a diff that contains the panic hook and the role logger, so observability code is mutated like product code. Each guard test in this plan (the base-missing guard and the mutants exit-code guard) kills its own remove-the-guard mutant within that run.
verification.ref: crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/run.rs::tests::{run_mutants_with_an_unreachable_base_is_base_missing_and_writes_no_diff, run_mutants_reports_survivors_of_an_untested_change, run_mutants_passes_when_the_change_is_tested, mutants_exit_codes_map_to_reasons, mutants_suite_counts_missed_and_timeout_as_survivors, resolve_base_needs_a_real_commit, chunk_diff_holds_tracked_edits_and_untracked_files} + plan gate `AGENT_RUN_CHUNK_BASE=13b7ee3… bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --mutants` (286 mutants: 244 caught, 42 unviable, 0 missed, 0 timeout; diff includes src/main.rs panic hook + src/run/mod.rs role logger) + .github/workflows/ci.yml job `mutants` (push + pull_request; CI witness = plan operator entries 17-18 at wrap)

record.notes:
2026-09-24 (2026-09-24-three-os-ci-headless-harness-skeleton, wrap P7): CI witness. The first push (b0236ca, run 35971295434) was red on all jobs: the test job lacked cargo-mutants, `ProcessId::kill` counted a Unix zombie as killed, and a viola-e2e-only diff failed the cargo-mutants baseline. The fix commit 966b7aa (run 35972580463) concluded success on test (windows-2025, macos-latest, ubuntu-latest) and mutants (base = github.event.before = b0236ca).

2026-09-24 (2026-09-24-fake-agent-and-test-data-fixtures, wrap P7): Rust-free diffs are no longer red. CI run 35973118026 (sha dc01bd9, the prior wrap's docs-only witness commit) failed `mutants` with `outcomes-missing`: cargo-mutants 27.1.0 exits 0 on a diff naming no `.rs` path and writes no `mutants.out/`. On a dev host the same exit left an earlier run's `outcomes.json` in place, and the gate read its stale counts as a pass. `run --mutants` now classifies `chunk.diff` itself. A Rust-free diff passes only with the explicit `{"tested":0,"verdict":"no-rust-delta","diff":"target/agent-run/chunk.diff","files":N}` and never reaches cargo-mutants. A Rust delta deletes a stale `outcomes.json` before the run, reports `"verdict":"counted"`, and stays red (`outcomes-missing`) with no fresh file. Refs: `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/run.rs::tests::{rust_delta_classifies_diff_headers, run_mutants_no_rust_delta_passes_by_name_and_never_reads_stale_outcomes, run_mutants_rust_delta_without_fresh_outcomes_is_outcomes_missing}`. The acceptance's base-missing and exit-code clauses are unchanged.
